purpose: Merged Archaeology / museum collection region matrix (Part A A–M + Part B N–Z leftovers). required_regions hold only valid Equilibrium region ids; invalid tokens stripped to unresolved_regions and mark status=unobtainable.

policy.unobtainable_rule: status=unobtainable when unresolved_regions.length > 0, or required_regions empty with dig_sites outside the valid dig→region map, or invalid region tokens were present on required_regions
